statement: A runnable Tier-3 demo exists under examples/service-data-affinity/ demonstrating code-near-data placement live: a real deployed native_js runtime service (a generic sql-query-loop lifecycle module registered in the production native_js handler map, which this quest wires end-to-end for the first time) issues the movielens top-10 SQL through its injected service-scoped query executor with read_locality=same_group, on a local multi-node cluster whose nodes carry operator-pinned zone labels (new latency.pinnedGroupId config + LATENCY_GROUP_ID env honored by the LatencyGroupManager as the single owner); the demo script deploys the service, observes service_partition_access attribution rows and services placement, and reports the service replicas converging into the data-holding zone. Deterministic guard tests (dt:prove red-on-revert) cover: the manager honoring a pinned group across assignment cycles, the sql-query-loop module issuing queries through the injected executor and stopping shutdown-aware, and the production handler-map wiring resolving runtime_ref through the real replica create/start path.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
